name: tiberius-smart-sites-funnel
description: Tiberius.ai Home Page (Tiberius Smart Sites $297/mo VSL Funnel) + Alfred AI (/alfred-ai) & Inner Pages

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});const files=['index.html','styles.css','app.js','nb-logo.png','legal.css','contact.html','privacy.html','terms.html','sms-terms.html','sms-consent.html'];for(const f of files){if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join('dist',f));}const dirs=['demos','images','assets','alfred-ai','receptionist','invoices','marketing','start','alfred','recon'];for(const d of dirs){if(fs.existsSync(d))fs.cpSync(d,path.join('dist',d),{recursive:true});}console.log('Built Tiberius.ai production bundle to dist/');"
